description: This file defines a package 'labels' for managing key-value labels, including interfaces, types, and functions for label manipulation, validation, and conversion within Kubernetes.

classes.name: Labels
classes.description: Interface for label operations such as Has, Get, and Lookup.

classes.name: Set
classes.description: Type alias for a map of string to string, representing label key-value pairs, with methods for string representation, existence check, retrieval, conversion, conflict detection, merging, and equality check.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns all labels as a human-readable string in key=value format, sorted for determinism.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if a label exists in the set.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given label key.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Returns the value and existence boolean for a label key.

methods.name: AsSelector
methods.description: Converts labels into a Selector without validation.

methods.name: AsValidatedSelector
methods.description: Converts labels into a validated Selector, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: AsSelectorPreValidated
methods.description: Converts labels into a Selector assuming they are already validated.

methods.name: FormatLabels
methods.description: Converts a label map into a string, returning '<none>' if empty.

methods.name: Conflicts
methods.description: Checks if two label sets have conflicting key-value pairs.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two label sets, with the second set overwriting conflicts.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two label sets are equal.

methods.name: ConvertSelectorToLabelsMap
methods.description: Parses a selector string into a label set with validation.
